title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Strawberry Raspberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: If you're a fan of delicious berry blends, then Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Strawberry Raspberry is the one you’ve been waiting for. When you take that first puff, you'll be enveloped in the lush sweetness of ripe, succulent strawberries, as if you’re snacking on the real thing at a summer picnic. This strawberry flavour is rich, juicy, and captures the authentic taste of the popular fruit in all its glory. But that's not the end of this flavour journey. As the strawberry notes settle, a delightful raspberry accent joins in. This raspberry addition brings a touch of tartness that perfectly offsets the strawberry's sweetness. It creates a harmonious blend of flavours, almost like a mouth-watering berry smoothie or a freshly baked berry tart, but without the added calories! Whether it's the dead of winter or the peak of summer, Strawberry Raspberry brings a dash of sunshine and liveliness to your vape. It’s a wonderfully simple yet perfectly balanced e-liquid that promises to keep your taste buds satiated all day long while keeping your cravings at bay. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
